purpose: Evidence gathered in real browsers, as opposed to host-side tests. Items 1, 2 and 3 of M3.5/CP-3B each require a property to hold in the browser, so each is recorded here as observed. Reproduce with `make wasm && make wasm-serve` and the probes described below.

runtimes_observed.probe_runtime: Pyodide 0.28.3, Python 3.13.2, LightGBM 4.6.0, numpy 2.2.5, wasm32 (OpenMP disabled)
runtimes_observed.marimo_pinned_runtime: Pyodide v314.0.0 as pinned by marimo 0.24.2, Python 3.14.2, LightGBM 4.6.0, numpy 2.4.3, wasm32

item_2_raw_heads_cross_build.what: All nine boosters loaded from model_to_string() text and predicted on the champion's own 24-row feature matrix for 2026-09-06; compared with the host (LightGBM 4.7.0, macOS arm64).

item_2_full_pipeline_in_page.what: The identity panel of the exported notebook, served from dist/space-wasm on a cold loopback origin, recomputing all 43 fixture days through features, nine heads, CQR and isotonic, against outputs recorded from the frozen mlflow.pyfunc champion.

item_3_delivery_day_availability_in_pyod.what: app/public/browser_champion.py executed in Pyodide on the shipped payload: the delivery day's 24 prices set to NaN, then separately every price of D-1 raised by 250 EUR/MWh.
item_3_delivery_day_availability_in_pyod.note: Identical to the CP-3 host figure (220.9433340396028) to full float precision: same delivery day, bitwise-equal pipeline.

item_1_controls_driven.served_from: dist/space-wasm over HTTP (file:// cannot run a WASM notebook)
item_1_controls_driven.quantile_selector: 95 % selected: band widened; annotation read 'empirical coverage at this level over the 90-day holdout was 0.9398'.
item_1_controls_driven.load_forecast_control: slider moved to x 1.06: all nine heads re-ran in the browser; 'Scenario active' with the sensitivity-probe label rendered; cleared-price line hidden (0 dashed polylines).
item_1_controls_driven.fan_chart: 1 inline SVG chart, 1 band polygon, median and outcome polylines
